52:t_000:0.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「All units, you heard it! The operation has failed! Jettison the Closer Pass and withdraw!」

52:t_000:1.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Get back, now! You'll be left behind!」

52:t_001:0.en:
$$レド$$
「Damn you, $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$...! How dare you!」

52:t_001:1.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Ensign $$レド$$, return to base!」

52:t_001:3.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「...Good. If you can hold out for 200 seconds, that's enough. Don't do anything reckless.」

52:t_001:4.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Once this operation is over, you should be permitted to travel to and stay on 《$$アヴァロン$$》.」

52:t_002:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「$$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#robot$$, withdrawing.」

52:t_004:1.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Fall back, $$レド$$! Leave this one to me!」

52:t_004:2.en:
$$レド$$
「Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$...! That would be a violation of military regulations!」

52:t_004:3.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「You're still young. You can kill more of the enemy than I can. That is a soldier's judgment.」

52:t_004:5.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Glory to the $$人類銀河同盟$$. Take care of yourself.」

52:t_004:7.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. A force other than the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ is approaching this area.」

52:t_005:1.en:
$$レド$$
「Do they mean to hit both us and the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ here!?」

52:t_005:2.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「All units, watch out! The enemy will use space-time weapons!」

52:t_006:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. Abnormal distortion of the surrounding dimensional boundaries confirmed. If this continues...」

57:t_1:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「He's been keeping quiet like that the whole time, huh?」

57:t_1:6.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Yeah. And with that tin-can bastard behind him, we can't lay a finger on him.」

57:t_1:7.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Going by the life-sign readings, that black machine seems able to operate even with no one aboard.」

57:t_1:8.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「You mean it moves even when nobody's riding it?」

57:t_1:9.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Yes. It seems it would carry out orders on his instructions.」

57:t_1:10.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「$$クルツ$$, $$ミシェル$$! Blast him through with your rifles like you did this afternoon!」

57:t_1:11.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Well, it's not like we can't do it, but...」

57:t_1:12.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I don't plan on doing anything that'll keep me up at night.」

57:t_1:13.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「What the hell! If it weren't for that guy, that tin-can bastard would be ours!」

57:t_1:14.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Knock it off, $$ピニオン$$. That's no different from how the pirates do things.」

57:t_1:15.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「$$ベローズ$$! You're taking his side too!?」

57:t_1:16.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「That guy tried to take $$エイミー$$ hostage and run for it!」

57:t_1:17.en:
$$エイミー$$
「But I don't think he's a bad person.」

57:t_1:20.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You think so too, $$ティファ$$?」

57:t_1:22.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Seriously? Both $$エイミー$$ and $$ティファ$$!?」

57:t_1:23.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Well, he fought to help the fleet, didn't he?」

57:t_1:24.en:
$$エイミー$$
「And even when he took me hostage, he wasn't all that scary.」

57:t_1:25.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You're out of your minds...! All of you!」

57:t_1:26.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「...I hear $$リジット$$ is going to call out to him tomorrow. Let's leave a lookout tonight and get some sleep, okay?」

57:t_1:27.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Sounds good. I'm worn out from the fighting this afternoon.」

57:t_1:33.en:
$$レド$$
[No... What's going to happen to us, I wonder...]

57:t_1:34.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Insufficient data to make a judgment.]

57:t_10:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「So you're AG. I've heard about you from $$ワッ太$$ and the others.」

57:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It must have been hard today, babysitting someone who won't even talk to you.」

57:t_10:8.en:
$$ガロード$$
「But $$ティファ$$ said he's not a bad guy.」

57:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even so, communicating with a sullen person like that must be rather tiring.」

57:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It would be a different story if the other party were a beautiful girl you'd fallen for at first sight, though.」

57:t_10:11.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Cut it out. $$ティファ$$ is not sullen at all.」

57:t_10:12.en:
$$ガロード$$
「She's quiet... no, demure... no, that's not it, refined... um...」

57:t_10:13.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Anyway, $$ティファ$$ is the best!」

57:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm sorry, $$ガロード$$... I really don't think I could beat you.」

57:t_10:15.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I don't really get it, but okay.」

57:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, $c has a specialist in babysitting sullen people, so let's leave it to them from now on.」

kept_omissions: 57:t_1:11: Michel's 'do it' (shoot him, per Pinion's order) kept as the bare 'it' of the Japanese
57:t_1:12: Kurz's object (shooting the pilot) left implicit as in the Japanese
uncertain: Brackets 【】 (Ledo/Chamber cockpit talk, rows 51:t_1:258 and 57:t_1:31-35): the checker rejects non-ASCII 【】, so they are written as ASCII [ ]; the Japanese marks them as a distinct (undiscussed-with-others) speech mode, so maybe the builder/font should handle 【】 or use parentheses instead
52:t_000:0 'Closer Pass' (クローザーパス): not in the glossary and I do not know what it is (device/item/operation); rendered literally, unmarked as a name
Speaker token for Chamber: used $$チェインバー#pilot$$ (pilot variant) for all Chamber lines and for the vocative in 57:t_1:31
52:t_002:0: Chamber's 'Striker X3752, withdrawing.' is Chamber naming its own unit with the robot token; could instead be a call-out addressed to Ledo
Ranks: 少尉 = Ensign (Ledo), 中佐 = Lieutenant Colonel (Kugel)
ヒディアーズ in speech uses the keyword token $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ (race) rather than #robot; 時空兵器 = 'space-time weapons'; 次元境界線 = 'dimensional boundaries'
57:t_1:10: Pinion's order to Kurz/Michel read as shooting Ledo himself (consistent with the next rows: 'that guy... tin-can would be ours'); 'blast him through' is my rendering of ぶち抜く
ムッツリ = 'sullen' throughout the AG/Garrod joke (Japanese also has a lewd-ish nuance that is lost)
57:t_10:16: $c left bare as the subject ('$c has a specialist'), so it reads as a name when expanded
Captions use tokens for Gargantia Fleet and D-Trader with the Jigoku-style spaces around the tildes
